label: P8 · Persistent mega-cap momentum
explanation: At each month-end, ranks point-in-time eligible U.S. common-stock issuers by a filing-dated market-cap proxy.
Selects issuers in the market-cap Top 20 that also rank in the top 20% on frozen 126-session Momentum and have remained Top 20 for at least three consecutive months.

Rebalances at the next regular-session open and holds until the following monthly rebalance. The primary account is equal-weight; a separate 25% position-cap account is tracked as a concentration stress.
This is forward paper monitoring of a post-hoc historical qualifier. It cannot place live orders and is not validated.
